admission.justification: A faster read could otherwise miss flagged changes or mutate the user index that a later commit relies on; the reference-state matrix and explicit original-index assertions pin both hazards.

applicability: Candidate-tree observations through the shared worktree_candidate_tree owner, for code and external memory repositories.
conditions: Git evidence is retained only for entries matching HEAD; staged changed/add/remove entries are restored before working files are added.
Assume-unchanged and skip-worktree flags are cleared only on the copy; objects are written into the addressed repository so candidates can be pinned.
Ignored staged paths absent from HEAD stay absent, and explicit caller-owned derived exclusions are preserved.
exclusions: Ordinary staging or commit operations intentionally using the real index.
An unchanged file is not reconverted merely because attributes, filters or core.autocrlf changed after its recorded stat evidence; the approved capture follows what that real index stages.
